title: Word-aligned 279-operation decoding with a shared shortened tail

claims.statement: The explicit product of thirty [64,32] components and the shortened 40-bit data tail, decoded by the shared-table program on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses, has average block error at most 24999113007274342919795920985103/25000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=279 primitives on every received word and W<=2^(124819/15364).

experiments.purpose: Recompute exact wide and reserved-key histograms in all four sectors. Sector zero also verifies the shortened histogram and fixed 279-operation schedule.
